text.p: RABAT, July 28 Reuter) - These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- France's Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine pays first visit to Morocco.
- Parliamentary team heads for Yemen to reinforce cooperation within Union of Arab Parliaments.
- Farmers' bank Caisse Nationale de Credit Agricole (CNCA) says it needs 800 million dirhams ($81.6 million) to recoup losses.
- Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique says it made 75 million dirhams ($7.5 million) profit in 1996.
- Moroccans devoted 4.0 percent of their spending to leisure in 1996 against 1.6 percent in 1985.
- French Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine's visit might give new impulse to French-Moroccan relations.
